verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only narrow, fixed event-driven behaviors that users can configure. A `pn patch` is persistently reapplied on every install, and a declared `packageManager`/`devEngines.packageManager` field triggers an automatic version switch on first use. Nothing documents a general mechanism for user-defined rules that trigger arbitrary actions on events. missing for 10: user-definable event hooks or rules (e.g. install/lifecycle hooks), documentation of a general trigger/action configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
